policy.rule_1: Every model, texture, font, photograph, music cue, voice and sound effect that ships needs a row here: creator, source, licence, permissions, processing history and use restrictions.
policy.rule_2: A generated asset requires BOTH visual and historical review before it enters the approved production library.
policy.rule_3: No asset may ship with review_status other than 'approved'. The weapon registry refuses to mark a weapon's model_status 'approved' without a provenance_ref, and a test asserts it.
policy.rule_4: Newly recorded or generated audio must never be described as an original wartime recording.
policy.rule_5: No critical feature may depend on an undocumented personal account or an asset that cannot legally ship.
policy.rule_6: Every row records may_ship: 'yes' (cleared), 'after_review' (licence or review outstanding), 'prototype_only' (never reaches the shipped game) or 'never' (a blockout or placeholder that must be replaced). A release build may contain only 'yes' rows, and the release gate checks it.

covers: district_normandy_bocage structures, hedgerows, vegetation, props and POIs
assets.creator: generated procedurally at runtime from shared-data/districts/*.json and gameplay code
assets.processing_history: authored as code, not imported; no third-party geometry was used
assets.use_restrictions: BLOCKOUT ONLY. Must not be shown as finished art and must not ship. Replace before any art gate.
assets.notes: Present so that the layout, collision, navigation, lighting and audio rules can be exercised and tested before production art exists.

covers: every surface and material in web/src/fps/materials.js and the fallbacks in godot/gameplay/fps/district_builder.gd
assets.creator: generated procedurally (value noise) at runtime
assets.processing_history: canvas-generated noise; no photographic or scanned source

assets.creator: Rasmus Andersson and contributors
assets.permissions: embedding and redistribution permitted under the OFL
assets.processing_history: loaded unmodified from the Google Fonts CDN
assets.use_restrictions: Verify the licence text at the point of shipping and include the required attribution. A Hebrew-capable face must be chosen and licensed separately before the Hebrew build ships.

assets.creator: three.js authors
assets.use_restrictions: Prototype only. The shipped game is Godot; three.js is not part of it.

required_before_launch: A row per production mesh, texture set, rig and animation clip.
A row per recorded foley take, with the recording date, location, microphone chain and processing history.
A row per music cue, with the composer, the rights record and whether any historical material was licensed.
A row per voice performance, with the performer, the language and the consent record.
A Hebrew-capable licensed typeface, and a check that every shipped font permits embedding.
A dependency licence audit: no copyleft or non-commercial dependency may reach the shipped build.
